title: label-write: refuse a state label (the six pm states incl. needs-user-decision) on a pull request, and pm:awaiting-merge on an issue
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: **③ a task on the maintainer's word.** The account owner, in `session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk`, answering this seat's proposal to file it: 「以上都同意」. Reader: triage routes it; the expected lane is `domain:skills` (`scripts/pm/**`, non-gate PM tooling).

## 维护者速读

规则早已写明:`needs-user-decision` 只挂决策卡、永不挂 PR,PR 等人批挂 `pm:awaiting-merge`(#29745 裁决 A,已落地)。但所有标签都经 `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` 写入,它不拦「把决策标签挂到 PR 上」。11-06 就发生了一次:cloud PR #3680 被挂上 `needs-user-decision`,从「待你审合」清单里消失,混进了决策箱。这张卡让写入口直接拒绝这种写法。

## Evidence

- `objectstack-ai/cloud` PR #3680: the timeline shows `labeled needs-user-decision by objectstack-fleet[bot]` at 2026-11-06T16:48Z, right after a Tier H ACCEPT (`6690246809`) that recommends merging; no decision was pending. Corrected by this seat in `6708398312`.
- `SKILL.md` L107: "`needs-user-decision` … 只挂决策卡(issue)、⛔ 永不挂 PR"; L189/L194: `pm:awaiting-merge` 只挂 PR.
- `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` on `main`: `refuseTwoStates` refuses two states on one card, but nothing reads whether the target is a pull request.
- `check-half-states.mjs` H48 finds a governed PR missing `pm:awaiting-merge` after the fact (report-only); it does not stop the write.

## Expected

- `label-write.mjs` reads the target once (it already reads the current label set in step ①; the issue object carries `pull_request`) and refuses, before any write and with the rule quoted: any of the six state labels (`pm:queue`, `pm:dispatched`, `pm:blocked`, `pm:on-hold`, `pm:awaiting-maintainer`, `needs-user-decision`) added to a pull request, and `pm:awaiting-merge` added to an issue.
- Removing a label is never refused (that is how a wrong one is cleaned up).
- A self-test case per direction.
- No new gate, workflow or label: it is the existing rule enforced at the single write door ("declared ≠ enforced" → enforce).

Dedupe (objectstack, open and closed): `label-write needs-user-decision pull request` → 752 hits (broad; the nearest relevant is #29745, the ruling that split the two inboxes, closed), `awaiting-merge only on pull requests` → 72 hits (#29745 again; no card enforces it at the write door).
